bias.en: Rebound · MACD crossed up, holding the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 上穿，守住 10 日均线

read.en: ASML slipped 0.1% on Nov 13 to $1,495.16, trading $1,462.41–1,506.51. It is below the 5-day ($1,509.6), just above the 10-day ($1,490.4) and below the 30-day ($1,619.6), 100-day ($1,707.3) and 200-day ($1,602.2); the 5-day and 200-day are rising. MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 13, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 10 ($1,374.90), and RSI is 42.2.

MACD completed the cross up flagged last session. The $1,462.41 low dipped under the $1,479–1,488 band but the close recovered above the 10-day. Resistance is $1,506.5–1,517.1 (Nov 13 high, 5-day, Nov 11 low), then $1,530.6–1,534.4 (Jul 29 low, Nov 11 close) and $1,545.7–1,563.5. Support is $1,479–1,490 (Nov 4 low, 10-day), then $1,443.5–1,468 and $1,375 (SAR). A close above $1,517 would target $1,531–1,546; below $1,462, $1,444.
